limitations: No financial evidence for CIB was provided; therefore CIB cannot be included in the comparison.

All P/E calculations use the price per share at the 2026‑11‑18 cutoff and the EPS figures as printed; any change in price or EPS would alter the ratios.
The recommendation assumes the investor can purchase whole shares at the given prices and that cash remaining after the purchase will be kept as a small buffer.
